name: Oswal Yarns Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Oswal Yarns Ltd manufactures and trades in yarn and Cloth[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
OYL is a part of the Oswal Group. It is engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading 
of knitted cloth, including textile, leather, and other apparel-related products. The company's yarn portfolio spans Cotton (Carded, Combed, 
Organic, BCI, and SUPIMA), Cotton-Polyester blends, and Value-Added Yarn (Grey) across various counts.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.60 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -8.87% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.89% over last 3 years.
